name: Lean
description: Installs elan, the Lean version manager, with the lean and lake commands, keeps Lean toolchains and the Lake and Mathlib caches on a volume that survives rebuilds, and optionally installs toolchains into the image.

elanVersion.description: The elan release to install: latest, the newest release at build time, or one release as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, 4.1.0 or later.

defaultToolchain.description: The toolchain elan uses outside a project, set each time the container is created: stable, beta, nightly, a release such as v4.35.0, or nightly-YYYY-MM-DD, optionally prefixed with leanprover/lean4: or leanprover/lean4-nightly:. Empty leaves elan's default to you.

preinstallToolchains.description: Toolchains to install into the image at build time, comma-separated, in the forms defaultToolchain accepts; each adds about 3 GB to the image.
